name: Intimacy
overview: Scripture reveals that intimacy encompasses both the sacred union between husband and wife and the believer's relationship with God. The marriage bond is designed to be a lifelong, exclusive commitment where a man leaves his parents to unite as one flesh with his wife, rejoicing in this blessed union (Genesis 2:24; Proverbs 5:18). God calls husbands to love their wives without bitterness, reflecting faithfulness and purity (Colossians 3:19; Malachi 2:15). Furthermore, believers are instructed to avoid all forms of sexual immorality and impurity, pursuing holiness as befits the saints (Ephesians 5:3; Colossians 3:5), highlighting that true intimacy honors God and reflects His design.
